text: だれでも　もってるのよ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いる shows an ongoing state; in speech the い drops, giving てる. もってる = 'has it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the feeling of explaining; のよ is the womanly form. もってるのよ = 'they have it, you see'.
